name: Kanda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kanda town emblem in maroon: an outlined ring crossed by a winged bar enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Kanda, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1955.

features.role: Kanda town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a winged bar enclosing a stylised mountain
